basics.name: Jordan Rivera
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer, Backend & Platform
basics.summary: Senior Software Engineer, 9 years across fintech, logistics, and consulting work, who builds internal platforms teams choose to adopt and keeps high-volume services fast and reliable. Built a shared deploy platform that 6 teams moved 40+ services onto, and cut payments-API p99 latency ~60% at ~1.2M transactions a day. Go, Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS. IC who mentors 3–4 engineers.

highlights: Built Acme Pay's first shared deploy platform (Go, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub Actions) and moved 40+ services from 6 teams onto it, cutting deploy lead time from ~3 days to under an hour.
Cut payments-API p99 latency ~60% at ~1.2M transactions a day by fixing PostgreSQL query plans and adding a Redis read path with write-through invalidation.
Introduced SLOs, OpenTelemetry tracing, and runbooks, bringing Sev-1 incidents from 14 to 5 a quarter and recovery time under 20 minutes.
Designed idempotency keys and a Kafka outbox for payment events, ending a class of duplicate-charge bugs. Cut compute spend ~35% with right-sizing and autoscaling.
Built the order-routing service from scratch in Go, replacing a Python cron job with an event-driven Kafka consumer and tripling peak throughput.
Cut the CI pipeline from 41 to 14 minutes by parallelizing tests, caching builds, and quarantining flaky tests.
Built backend APIs for 6 consultancy client projects in Python and PostgreSQL, including a retail inventory sync that went to production at 40 stores.

projects.name: Open-source Go middleware
projects.description: 23 merged PRs to a public Go HTTP-middleware library, mostly retry and timeout handling. 2 meetup talks on platform engineering.
